name: Ford - Dearborn Engine Plant, Dearborn MI

fieldNotes.site: Dearborn Engine Plant (DEP / Dearborn Engine and Fuel Tank Plant) is an interior building of Ford's Rouge Center campus. Roster geocode (42.3145,-83.1621) landed on the north edge of the green-roofed Dearborn Truck Plant. Satellite identification (z16-z19) located the engine plant as the long large NW-SE building immediately east of the Truck Plant, flanked by rail spurs on its NE face; center relocated to ~42.3128,-83.1588.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The Rouge Center is a fully fenced, guarded campus. Street View along the internal access road shows chain-link perimeter fence with privacy slats around the engine plant; the plant is served by the Rouge gate/guard system rather than its own street-facing gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Rouge Center operates manned security gates with guard booths (confirmed at the SW Rouge gate in idx-11 imagery). The engine plant shares this campus gate system.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Low confidence - engine plant interior to the Rouge with material flow largely internal and by rail; few external truck docks visible. Estimated 0-10 on the SW building face.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: DEP is one of ~93 Rouge Center buildings; Dearborn Truck Plant and the Rouge Electric Vehicle Center are immediately adjacent on the same secured campus.
fieldNotes.railServed: Multiple rail spurs run directly alongside the engine plant building's NE face - clearly rail-served.
fieldNotes.dropArea: No dedicated trailer drop yard for this interior building. The finished-vehicle staging lots seen nearby belong to the adjacent Truck Plant. dropYard false.
fieldNotes.perimeter: Box approximates the engine plant building footprint (~31 acres) within the larger Rouge campus.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Detroit/Dearborn metro industrial fabric - Urban.
